properties.name: Fyodorov north
properties.note: Outline traced by eye on satellite imagery, not a surveyed boundary. For this demo we assumed fallow in 2019 and 2023 from the look of the imagery; no farmer was consulted.

properties.name: Shortandy west
properties.note: Outline traced by eye on satellite imagery, not a surveyed boundary. For this demo we assumed fallow in 2021 and a crop in 2023; the satellite curve alone cannot tell a failed crop from a weedy fallow, and no farmer was consulted.
